events.title: Constantius II makes his only visit to Rome
events.description: Emperor Constantius II entered Rome in triumph for the first time. The historian Ammianus Marcellinus described his astonishment at the Forum of Trajan and other monuments.
events.html: Emperor Constantius II entered Rome in triumph for the first time. The historian Ammianus Marcellinus described his astonishment at the Forum of Trajan and other monuments.

events.title: Fletcher Christian leads the mutiny on the Bounty
events.description: Mutineers seized HMS Bounty and set Captain William Bligh adrift with 18 men in an open launch. Bligh navigated some 6,700 km to Timor with the loss of only one man.
events.html: Mutineers seized HMS Bounty and set Captain William Bligh adrift with 18 men in an open launch. Bligh navigated some 6,700 km to Timor with the loss of only one man.

events.title: Rush-Bagot Agreement is proclaimed
events.description: President Monroe proclaimed the Anglo-American agreement limiting warships on the Great Lakes and Lake Champlain. It helped demilitarise the border between the United States and British North America.
events.html: President Monroe proclaimed the Anglo-American agreement limiting warships on the Great Lakes and Lake Champlain. It helped demilitarise the border between the United States and British North America.

events.title: Partisans shoot Mussolini near Lake Como
events.description: Benito Mussolini and Clara Petacci were shot by partisans at Giulino di Mezzegra. The next day their bodies were hung upside down in Milan's Piazzale Loreto.
events.html: Benito Mussolini and Clara Petacci were shot by partisans at Giulino di Mezzegra. The next day their bodies were hung upside down in Milan's Piazzale Loreto.

events.title: Japan regains its sovereignty as the Allied occupation ends
events.description: The Treaty of San Francisco came into force, ending the Allied occupation of Japan that had begun in 1945. A US-Japan security treaty took effect the same day.
events.html: The Treaty of San Francisco came into force, ending the Allied occupation of Japan that had begun in 1945. A US-Japan security treaty took effect the same day.

events.title: Charles de Gaulle resigns as President of France
events.description: After voters rejected his referendum on regional and Senate reform, de Gaulle stepped down at noon. He had led the Fifth Republic since its foundation in 1958.
events.html: After voters rejected his referendum on regional and Senate reform, de Gaulle stepped down at noon. He had led the Fifth Republic since its foundation in 1958.
